name: Suzuki Reiko
source: Reiko is the wife of Suzuki Ken'ichi, manager of the convenience store "New Life". She and her husband are devoted to each other, but Reiko was not blessed with children. As a result of the stress at work, the couple has been growing colder towards each other.
